searchText: How hard do we want to press people on inlining test cases and and reference implementations in EIPs? Not anymore I can all but guarantee most of these links people put to external implementations and test cases are going to disappear some day before the EIPs repository disappears and we'll have a bunch of 404s. That was more for consideration for Accepted, which no longer exists I believe other standards groups require inlining. <@!187490121698770945> Are you suggesting we just remove those two sections from the EIP? I’m suggesting we re-evaluate now that the focus of the EIP repo has changed I support removing the Implementation section, though I think Test Cases is valuable, but I think it should be inlined and perhaps optional? Both sound good to me. Test cases are a good way to sure up a standard. Good ones are more likely to have them, but I don’t think it should be required. A best practice, but not a requirement. <@!425279588009246720> Can we adjust the text on the stale bot a bit? Something that indicates that if there is no outstanding feedback, then just add a comment requesting an editor review?
